outcome: aborted by harness tool-call timeout (not a product failure)
detail: The first invocation was started as a foreground shell command; the harness terminated the tool call while the script was inside the 32 s frame-observation window of phase4. The script never reached its `finally` restore/cleanup block, so the global settings were left at the modified values (heartbeat_interval_sec=3, revision_check_interval_sec=5, max_log_bytes=2048).
harness_fix: attempt02 runs the same script under `nohup` with the stdout/stderr captured to run-stdout.log/run-stderr.log and is polled from the harness, so a harness-side tool timeout can no longer kill the run in the middle of the settings-modification window.
conclusion: harness defect, not a product defect; no product behaviour conclusion is drawn from attempt01
